name: Ranjana
bio:
Computer Science and Information Technology faculty member experienced in higher education, student mentoring, laboratory coordination, assessment preparation and academic documentation. Skilled in lesson plans, lecture notes, assignments and question papers, explaining programming and IT concepts through practical examples. Currently Guest Faculty at Rajkiya Engineering College (REC), Azamgarh.

LOCATION & PERSONAL DETAILS
Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Date of birth: 10/01/1998.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Guest Faculty — Rajkiya Engineering College (REC), Azamgarh | Present
• Teaching Computer Science / Information Technology subjects and supporting students’ academic progress.
• Preparing lesson plans, lecture notes, assignments, question papers and internal assessment materials.
• Conducting practical sessions, resolving student queries and supporting project-based learning.
• Maintaining academic records and contributing to departmental and examination-related activities.

Assistant Professor — BBD Group of Institutions, Lucknow | July 2024 – October 2025
• Delivered Computer Science / IT lectures and tutorials using practical examples and student-centred teaching.
• Prepared lesson plans, notes, assignments, question papers and internal assessment material.
• Conducted practical sessions supporting programming fundamentals, laboratory activities and project-based learning.
• Mentored students and maintained attendance, assessment data and departmental documentation.

Assistant Professor — RR Group of Institutions, Sitapur Road, Lucknow | October 2023 – July 2024
• Taught Computer Science / IT concepts through classroom teaching, assignments and practical activities.
• Supported syllabus coverage, internal assessments, attendance records, laboratory work and student guidance.
• Assisted with examination duties, departmental documentation and academic support activities.

ACADEMIC PROJECTS
IoT-Based Door Lock Sensor Using Arduino — Developed an IoT-based door lock sensor in the final semester of M.Sc. IT using Arduino, sensors and basic automation concepts.
Indian Employment Card Project — Created an Indian Employment Card project in the final year of B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering.

CERTIFICATIONS
• Cyber Security Skill Program Certification — IIT Kanpur.
• C Programming Language Certification.

LANGUAGES
Hindi and English.
